# Pull Request: Enhanced Question Generator and Automated Build

## Description

This PR implements the enhanced question generator for Truth or Dare Deluxe, creating 1000 questions per category for Classic, Couples, and Party modes, and 100 questions per category for Drink mode. It also adds a GitHub Actions workflow for automated builds.

## Changes

- Added enhanced question generator with mode-specific templates
- Created GitHub Actions workflow for automated builds
- Added comprehensive documentation
- Implemented test scripts for verification

## Question Generation

- Classic mode: 1000 questions per category (12,000 total)
- Couples mode: 1000 questions per category (12,000 total)
- Party mode: 1000 questions per category (12,000 total)
- Drink mode: 100 questions per category (1,200 total)

## Testing

- Created test scripts to verify question generator functionality
- Manually verified question structure and content
- Tested GitHub Actions workflow locally

- Updated README.md with new features
- Added QUESTION_GENERATOR_README.md with detailed instructions
- Created GITHUB_ACTIONS_GUIDE.md for workflow usage
- Added IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md with overview of changes
